dogecoin.text: @qryptoo Sorry we don't accept dogecoin, but we do take ⚡ #Bitcoin
Was talking about steak in a twitter space and now I get this ad. At least it's not another damn dogecoin ad. https://t.co/2f66aacwOq
Who are the dogecoin developers? Well it’s a straightforward fork of #Bitcoin so take a wild ass guess.

The Federal Reserve is doing such a terrible job managing the dollar that literally #dogecoin does a better job of managing inflation. Looking closer, dogecoin has actually some positive aspects of money, avoiding the deflationary properties of bitcoin. Dogecoin standard?

@denverbitcoin Deflationary currencies stifle investment, discourage economic activity, and punish businesses for holding inventory. Hoarding does not make for a vibrant economy. Good money has low but stable inflation. #Bitcoin is more like gold than money. I think #dogecoin could be money.

@RawEgNationalsm @romarioisback I’m a #Bitcoin maxi but I also like #dogecoin. I enjoyed the community they built when it was first released, and I can see that it has significant potential in the future. Why the doge hate?

@romarioisback I see #dogecoin as a lighthearted friendly community bringing in masses of people into the crypto sphere. Once they see the value proposition of a finite supply, they will become #bitcoin maxis, as so many did before them. It’s one of the only cryptos that’s not an outright scam.
@Sheryar99588191 @elonmusk There will always be enough for everyone. With doge 1.21 atomic swaps with #Bitcoin will be possible making #dogecoin a strong competitor to lightning as a payment rail.

@MSneakhead13 @QueenofDogecoin @jack Anyhow, once upon a time I got one of the first batches of scrypt ASICs, and managed to solo mine a block of #dogecoin. These were the most evil little devices on the planet, always trying to eat fingers. https://t.co/D4B4KJx33b

@BIGGUCCIDRACOTX @BillyM2k @GIGACHAD2021 @itsALLrisky This is actually great, because it’s genesis was not a scam to enrich the founders. It was created as an actual joke, and built a great community of friendly users that mined on desktop GPUs and tipped each other in #dogecoin. They inadvertently created a masterpiece.

@NakamotoNinja @jillruthcarlson @zooko @hashbreaker It’s a concern, along with block size, memory, and bandwidth. At least #dogecoin doesn’t have taproot to worry about like #Bitcoin does, which is a mistake in regards to having a path forward for quantum resistance.

@notgrubles How about this use case? Atomic swap to #dogecoin and use it as a payment network, no worrying about payment channel liquidity or needing to use custodial solutions. Any serious lightning user is acutely aware of the no route, no liquidity pain.

@phil_geiger Do you store wealth is disinflationary digital gold, or inflationary digital cash? Both will likely play a tremendous role in the future of finance. Are #bitcoin and #dogecoin really both competing to be money?

@RealNatashaChe Please do the same analysis but for #dogecoin. I think you’ll find that it’s a closer match to your understanding of money. #Bitcoin is a reserve asset that backs all other forms of money in the crypto space.

@LeonidasNFT Dogecoin is a fork of bitcoin with 10x base capacity, an inflation rate that is persistent and reasonably low, basically it works as traditional money. Also it wasn’t created to enrich its founders, rather was made as a joke. A wholesome community with a strong tipping culture
